Class OperationTags

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.instrumentation.bridge.OperationTags
public final class OperationTags extends Object
The operation names the woven advice passes to BootstrapDispatcher.

The bridge runs in the bootstrap class loader, which cannot see the API's OperationType, so operations cross it by name. These constants make a misspelled name a compile error instead of a failure on the first intercepted call; they are inlined where used. Each is the name of an OperationType constant, except FILE_IO_TRANSFER_TO and FILE_IO_TRANSFER_FROM, the file-channel transfers the core maps to reads and writes, and SCHEDULE_SUBMIT_PERIODIC, a periodic SCHEDULE_SUBMIT.
